items.title: Why Is Dynatrace (DT) Pairing AI Security With Observability Now?
items.summary: Dynatrace (NYSE:DT) and CrowdStrike announced a new partnership to link AI-driven security with observability offerings. The collaboration aims to support federated search, shared security context, and flexible data routing for joint enterprise customers. Both businesses plan to use each other's platforms internally, signaling a deeper product and go to market alignment.
